name: Mail
short_desc: One inbox for your Google and Microsoft mail. Connect from inside Mail.
author: Humanity Labs
description: A clean mail client for the Google and Microsoft accounts connected on this Wizard: unified inbox, search, safe reading (no scripts, remote pictures blocked until you allow them), write, reply, forward, archive and delete. Connect accounts from inside Mail through the Google and Microsoft apps (Quick connect through Composio, or your own app). Your agent can read and draft but not send.
